days.details: No ride after the weekend long ride. Strength A, about 25 min: tick each exercise off on Today. Use a dumbbell or kettlebell, or bodyweight; stop 2 reps short of failure.
days.actual: 3.3 mi ride to the store. Strength A not done: moved to Wednesday.

days.details: 15 min easy, then 2 × 20 min at the top of Zone 3 with 5 min easy between. Seated, steady cadence 85–95. Dropped: easy riding only until the 5,000 km goal is in the bag.

Day off work. Ride first: conversational pace on a flat route, HR strap on, stretch it out if you feel good. Then Strength A (about 25 min, moved from Monday): tick each exercise off on Today. Stop 2 reps short of failure, since hills are tomorrow.

Warm up 20 min, then 5 × 3 min hard on a steady climb, roll back down to recover. Kennesaw prep. If the legs are heavy from Wednesday's squats, do 4 repeats instead of 5. Dropped: easy riding only until year end.

days.session: Easy Zone 2 (+ Strength B if you like)
days.details: Easy, conversational, flat route. Strength B after only if you feel like it.
All easy, no efforts. 30 mi is plenty for the season goal; go to 55+ only if you feel good, since every 55-mile day counts for Eddington. Eat every 45 min.
If Saturday rains out, ride the long easy ride today. Otherwise an easy spin or off.
